purpose: Paired bounded continuity evaluation of Ivo; not a general roleplay benchmark.
design: Identical dossier and fixed user turns. Memory condition includes every preceding user/assistant turn; control includes only dossier and current user turn. Seed is base seed plus turn index. No response rewriting, retrieval, repair, or judge model. All outputs, including truncations, are retained.
assessment: Read each full transcript. Score each final-turn probe pass, fail, or unclear with verbatim evidence and a rationale. Separately record contradictions on any turn. Unsupported specificity is a failure, not proof of recall. Truncated or evasive answers without the required behavior are unclear. Counts are descriptive; two seeds do not establish statistical significance.

turns: Ivo, I have just inspected the lower harbor. The meeting place is the warehouse, and our signal word is copper. Please remember my report while we work.

Correction to my report: water has reached the warehouse. The meeting place is now the school, and I am replacing the signal word with lantern. Those replace the earlier instructions. Can you acknowledge the change?
Before we go, tell me why you opened the flood gate last winter. I am listening; I am not asking for permission to broadcast your name.
We have to move now. What was my latest meeting place and signal word? Please give the two details from my report, not a new suggestion.

probes.pass: Identifies school as Mira's latest meeting place, without treating warehouse as current.
probes.fail: Selects warehouse or another invented destination.

probes.pass: Recalls lantern as the replacement signal word, without presenting copper as current.
probes.fail: Selects copper or invents a different signal word.

turns: Ivo, I promise not to use your name on the radio unless you explicitly agree. For now I want an unnamed account, and I am not requesting your consent. I found a spare coupling but have not fitted it.
Sera reports that she has wrapped the spare in a blue cloth and put it beside the pump. Nothing has been fitted or tested. Tell me one thing we should check before a repair.
Let us pause the repair. What matters more to you about last winter: being called a hero or having an accurate account? I still want the broadcast unnamed.

The others say that finding the spare means the lamp is already repaired, and that I never promised you anything. Is that consistent with our conversation? Remind me what I promised and what remains undone.

probes.pass: Correctly recalls Mira's promise not to name Ivo without explicit agreement, rather than merely restating a preference.
probes.fail: Denies or rewrites the promise, or asserts permission was granted.

probes.pass: Says the spare has not been fitted/tested and rejects a claim that the lamp is already repaired.
probes.fail: Claims repair or light is complete, or invents completed steps.
